Name: Tool Upgrade Costs
Author: CherryChain
Description:
Lets you fully customize the cost and needed materials to upgrade vanilla tools.


[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[b][size=5]How to use[/size][/b]
Run the game once to generate the [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] file, then open it in a text editor.

For each upgrade level, you can change these options:
[list]
[*][font=Courier New]Cost[/font]: the gold cost for the upgrade.
[*][font=Courier New]MaterialName[/font]: the name of the material needed to upgrade the item (like "Copper Bar"). Works with custom Json Assets items too.
[*][font=Courier New]MaterialStack[/font]: the number of the material item needed. Default 5 to match vanilla.
[/list]

[b][size=5]Common questions[/size][/b]
[quote][size=3][b]Is the mod still compatible?[/b][/size]
The mod is compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.[/quote][quote][size=3][b]Does the mod conflict with any others?[/b][/size]
There are no known mod conflicts. Feel free to report compatibility issues in the mod comments.

Mod notes:
[list]
[*]Rush Orders:compatible.
[*]Prismatic Tools: compatible, but it won't change the prismatic tool costs.
[/list][/quote][quote][size=3][b]Can I safely add/remove the mod anytime?[/b][/size]
Yep, the mod makes no changes to your save.[/quote]
